# Nanoencapsulation_Stability_Bioavailability

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of enclosing nutraceuticals in nanoscale carriers to protect them from degradation and enhance their absorption in the body. Provides a cross-domain model for understanding how encapsulation and controlled release dynamics can be mapped to information retention and signal propagation in TCC/iNEST systems.
